items.title: Meet Ohaebosim, first Nigerian-American to become lieutenant governor in US
items.summary: Wichita Democrat KC Ohaebosim has been elected Lieutenant Governor of Kansas, becoming the first Nigerian-American to hold such an office in the US. Read More: https://punchng.com/meet-ohaebosim-first
